newsSectionContent.title: Eurovision Voting App
newsSectionContent.description: Eurovision voting app is one of my latest projects. It is a project that constitutes of a full-stack application and a server. As a fun of eurivision song contest, I came with the idea of creating a way that my friends and I could vote for every country, in order to avoid writing the results on paper. In this way, not only could we vote more easily, but we could also get informed about the points that each person has allocated among countries.
